early_stop_rule: Reject the branch if the initial run and single same-lineage extension fail the development behavior gates. Do not rescue it with control-width, taxonomy, recovery-horizon, pointer-weight, loss-weight, vocabulary, or decoder sweeps.

hypothesis.claim: Supervised factorization of an encode-once prompt into global, task, and topic records, combined with sparse topic-sequence copying and multi-horizon on-policy recovery, will prevent latent-record collapse and sustain prompt adherence across the complete response while retaining the fast shared-BPE sparse decoder.
hypothesis.material_difference_from_closed_branches: Prior semantic records were unsupervised and collapsed; direct token memory had no explicit task/topic factorization and recovery covered only a fixed 12-unit prefix. This branch supervises factor identity from knowledge-light training metadata, uses a neural topic locator and task classifier at encode time, and trains recovery at fixed 8, 32, and 64-unit horizons.
hypothesis.representation: locked shared 2816-unit English BPE from the prior representation bake-off
hypothesis.runtime_control: three fixed records injected into the neural decoder; all selection remains neural
hypothesis.sparse_topic_copy: topic-locator weights are scattered only onto source token IDs with a learned successor bias

promotion_rule: Only one integrated checkpoint lineage may supply quality, behavior, speed, TTFT, RSS, sparsity, incremental-state, and ABI evidence.
systems_optimization_rule: At most one profiler-directed runtime optimization, only after behavioral quality passes and speed or RSS is within 10 percent of its gate.

training_contract.curriculum: the frozen knowledge-light semantic-control v2 corpus
